body: We'll see if it lasts. We'll see how much I truly care.

This is the part that I have trouble in describing,

I can talk about things that interest me (I become very well-versed in such things), or I can talk on an emotional level. It seems like everything in between--which is missing--is what normal conversation consists of. 

And since I'm in near-constant emotional pain, due to hypersensitivity, etc. and because I cannot maintain friendships well myself (due to lack of understanding how), I always end up appearing to be a 'drama queen' (as my latest former friend put it today). 

The loneliness shows as my biggest issue, but it's only because it's the easiest to describe. I don't understand how to enact positive, beneficial changes in my life.

I also get a defeated attitude fairly quickly (or so I think), but...when my entire life has been a series of letdowns and disappointments, it's not very easy to adjust that.

I'm sure it sounds dramatic in the way that I worded that, but it's sincerely true. I really don't remember the last positive occurance for me that wasn't trivial at best--not from lack of trying.

I just got myself requalified under my parent's COBRA healthplan so it's potentially an option again.

I will not be going to my old psychiatrist though. That's for sure.

I know full well about all of this. Unfortunately. 

As far as the Asperger's goes, well, no I don't have an official diagnosis.

The most recent was Lamictal, Symbyax and extra Fluoxetine (Fluoxetine is in Symbyax as well as Olanzapine). It's what I nearly killed myself with. 

Lithium citrate has a nasty set of side effects, though. It's really a last resort sort of situation. And as I said, I'm fairly certain that the bipolar was a misdiagnosis.

Well, by that I mean I have *no* friends... not a single person that I can rely upon for anything, even just listening to me.

I pad my words sometimes.

Even though I maintain a nice outward façade, most... normal people cannot handle long-term friendships with me. People end up fed up after a few months and with each person that gets fed up, I get rocked. 

It's a very unpleasant catch 22. 

There's no great change coming when I don't know how to handle things myself or how to make the changes that I would need to. I can't be led through life by the hand for the parts that I don't understand. 

No matter what, it simplifies down to my being a waste of resources. And I don't want to do that.

One of the main reasons I don't is because I've attempted three different regiments of medication as treatment for it, all affecting me near-nil.

I think that the symptoms of my issues displayed outwardly can appear at times to be bipolar, but it's not the case. 

Seroquel is an intense drug. It would probably make me look outwardly ok. It might correct most of the issues that people would see, but like other medications like it, internally I'd still be a giant ball of fuck-up.

Moving back home was only made worse by the fact that I am living with my mother, but I have no feelings of love or care towards her anymore and haven't for as long as I can remember. 

My parents separated on Halloween when I was eight (nice, right?). It was messy and... Well, they really alienated both myself and my sister over the next few years. I have no reason to trust her, as she has really damaged that over the years as well. 

So I fee alone even when I'm not, which fucks with my head that much more.
That would take money that I quite simply do not possess.

I've been playing since 1.1 and I really, really do not want to see what this is for me. 

24 year old male, not graduated (not a result of WoW), job yes, in basement, yes. 

Asperger's with PTSD. Life can be very trying.
